purpose: Seed castles, ruins and chateaus with coordinates.
query: SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?coord ?countryLabel WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q23413; wdt:P625 ?coord. OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P17 ?country. } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,cs". } } LIMIT 1000
notes: Use as candidate seed only; verify legend/theme manually.
